notes.title: Release Date / New Capsule Art / New Gameplay Trailer
notes.content:
Recently I was able to capture some more footage and thus created a gameplay trailer. It's now live. 

[previewyoutube=IlsHK9swagA;full][/previewyoutube]

Additionally I had some key art created that really gives some personality to Little Devils. You can see this live on the store page and across Steam.

We are quickly approaching our launch on [b]February 29th[/b]. 

This is a truly exciting time. I can't wait for everyone to be able to take the plunge to the depths of hell with our intrepid hero. 

See you soon.
